name: ST-LINK/V2-1 debug probe
description: ST's ST-LINK/V2-1, the debugger and programmer on a NUCLEO-64 (UM1724 6.2), firmware V2J37M26 (0483:374B). Its SWD lines and NRST go to the target, T_VCC senses the target's supply. A debugger on the computer reaches it through the session's stlink-server (stlink.serve, the TCP service STM32CubeIDE and OpenOCD's `st-link backend tcp` use): its commands, as OpenOCD 0.12 sends them, halt, step and run the target's core, read and write its registers and memory and program its flash, all through the target's debug port.

pins.name: SWDIO
pins.doc: SWD data, to the target's SWDIO (PA13 on an STM32): the MCU on this net is the probe's target

pins.name: SWCLK
pins.doc: SWD clock, to the target's SWCLK (PA14); held high-impedance, as the clock is not simulated edge by edge

pins.name: NRST
pins.doc: The target's reset, pulled low by DRIVE_NRST (open drain)

pins.name: T_VCC
pins.doc: VDD_TARGET: the target's supply, read by GET_TARGET_VOLTAGE; below 1.65 V no target answers

pins.name: SWO
pins.doc: The target's serial wire output (PB3's TRACESWO on an STM32, through SB15 on a NUCLEO-64): the probe's UART receiver for SWO trace

pins.name: USB_DP
pins.doc: Its USB D+ (CN1 on a NUCLEO-64): the probe's own USB device, 0483:374B

pins.name: VBUS
pins.doc: The USB cable's 5 V (U5V), which powers the probe

serial.doc: The probe's serial number (24 hex digits), as GET_DEV_INFO and USB report it

drive.doc: The label of its mass-storage drive (the board's name)

outputs.name: mode
outputs.doc: The firmware's mode: mass (the default), debug once a debugger entered SWD, dfu

outputs.name: swd
outputs.doc: SWD entered: the target's debug port is in use

outputs.name: target
outputs.doc: The MCU on SWDIO's net, empty when none

outputs.name: target_voltage
outputs.doc: T_VCC as the probe measures it

outputs.name: commands
outputs.doc: Commands answered since the session started

outputs.name: log
outputs.doc: What the probe did: SWD entered and left, NRST driven

functional.claims: The ST-LINK/V2-1's command interface as firmware V2J37M26 answers it and OpenOCD 0.12's stlink_usb.c reads it: GET_VERSION, GET_CURRENT_MODE, DFU_EXIT, GET_TARGET_VOLTAGE (T_VCC against its 1.2 V reference); in DEBUG mode APIV2_ENTER (SWD), EXIT, READ_IDCODES (the target's SW-DP IDCODE), SWD_SET_FREQ, DRIVE_NRST (low, high, a 2 ms pulse on its open-drain NRST), RESETSYS (AIRCR.SYSRESETREQ), GETSTATUS, FORCEDEBUG, RUNCORE, STEPCORE, READREG and WRITEREG through DCRSR and DCRDR, READALLREGS, READDEBUGREG and WRITEDEBUGREG, memory reads and writes of 8, 16 and 32 bits and 32 bits without increment, GETLASTRWSTATUS(2) with the faulting address, READ_DAP_REG and WRITE_DAP_REG (DP: DPIDR, CTRL/STAT, SELECT, RDBUFF; MEM-AP: CSW, TAR, DRW, BASE, IDR), INIT_AP and CLOSE_AP_DBG; SWO trace: START_TRACE_RX (the rate, at most 2 MHz), STOP_TRACE_RX, GET_TRACE_NB and the trace endpoint's read (stlink-server's READ_SWO), its UART receiver on the SWO pin taking the target's serial wire output into a 4 KiB buffer, NRZ only and within 3 % of its rate (else garbage, counted and not kept); status 0x80, 0x81, 0x09 when no target answers, 0x11 for an AP fault. Its target is the MCU on SWDIO's net, reached through that MCU's MEM-AP. Shared with the host by the session's stlink-server (stlink.serve). Its own USB device on its USB_DP and USB_DM pins (the NUCLEO's CN1): full-speed composite 0483:374B, "STMicroelectronics" / "STM32 STLink" with its serial number, the debug interface (0x01 OUT commands, 0x81 IN answers, 0x82 IN trace), the mass-storage drive and the virtual COM port's interfaces; the drive is a FAT16 volume labelled `drive` (NODE_F446RE) with MBED.HTM and DETAILS.TXT, and a .bin copied onto it is programmed through the target's flash interface (the core halted, KEYR unlocked, each sector erased with SER and STRT, the words programmed at PSIZE x32 with BSY polled, locked, the part reset), at the flash's own times; the probe then leaves the bus and comes back with the file gone, or with FAIL.TXT when it could not program it.
omissions: SWD as transactions, not SWDIO and SWCLK edges; a command takes no simulated time
SWO in Manchester (the V2-1 reads NRZ only: a Manchester output arrives as garbage); JTAG, SWIM, its own firmware upgrade (DFU)
a host tool that opens the USB device itself (st-flash, CubeProgrammer without stlink-server) does not reach it: its USB device is on the bench's cable, not the computer's (USB/IP)
the virtual COM port's data on USB (its endpoints NAK; the board's console bridge stands for the port, its line coding is kept)

the drive's geometry and the words of MBED.HTM, DETAILS.TXT and FAIL.TXT (EmbSIM's); .hex files; targets other than the STM32F446 (their copy fails with FAIL.TXT); the firmware's MAINTENANCE mode; USB suspend

sources.title: ST UM1724, STM32 Nucleo-64 boards, 6.2 (the embedded ST-LINK/V2-1)
sources.notes: Its SWD, NRST and VDD_TARGET wiring on MB1136
